Cartier · ref. WSSA0037

Santos

Pilot/Sports · 24.5mm to 43.3mm · 30m to 100m · automatic · 2018–2023

The Cartier Santos is a pioneering family of watches, recognized as one of the first wristwatches created for men and the original pilot's watch. Its design is defined by a square case with exposed screws on the bezel, Roman numerals, and an elegant yet functional aesthetic.

The story

Originally designed in 1904 by Louis Cartier for his friend, the aviator Alberto Santos-Dumont, the watch was commercially introduced in 1911. A significant turning point came in 1978 with the introduction of the Santos de Cartier, a sportier version in steel and two-tone with an integrated bracelet that became an icon of the 1980s. The design evolved with the more curved Santos Galbée in 1987, the larger and more robust Santos 100 for its centenary in 2004, and a major redesign in 2018 that introduced the modern Santos de Cartier with the QuickSwitch strap system.
